output.population: 632 patients with COVID-19 infections, all with a positive RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2 obtained within 1 day of the initial CT
output.summary: Retrospective chest CT images, converted to NIfTI, from patients with RT-PCR-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection imaged at the point of care in an outbreak setting; used for training classification models.
